_comment: The bestiary's sprite manifest, in the order a player MEETS these creatures:
forest/field and mire are gated at d0, ashfall at 250, desert at 400, tundra at 550
([biome_gate] in balance.toml), and forest_bloom_stalker is the tutorial creature -
the first thing anyone ever fights. Generating in this order means the shallow end
is finished art first, which is what almost every player actually sees.
Each species is TWO characters. A pack's leader and its minions are the same
species at 1.7x and 0.45x HP, and drawing them from one sprite made a 3.8x health
gap read as a bug; size alone (pack_scale) helped but a minion is meant to be a
different ANIMAL of the same kind - a runt, a drone, a fledgling. Same palette and
same silhouette family so the pack reads as one group, different build so you can
tell at a glance which one is worth the turn.
style: in a weird HD-2D fantasy style

creatures.leader: a huge predatory fungal stalker, a long-legged spider-like body of pale woody chitin with a cluster of glowing violet spore-blooms erupting from its back, four barbed legs, no eyes
creatures.minion: a small young fungal stalker, a squat pale-chitin crawler with a single half-open violet spore-bloom on its back and stubby barbed legs, no eyes
creatures.attack: lunging forward and striking with a barbed foreleg

creatures.leader: an enormous scarred wild boar with a ridge of long black thorns down its spine, heavy curved yellow tusks, matted brown bristles and a torn ear
creatures.minion: a small young wild boar with a short stubble of dark thorns along its spine, little tusks and soft brown bristles
creatures.attack: charging forward and goring with its tusks

creatures.leader: a bloated walking mushroom creature, a thick mottled cream-and-ochre cap over a stumpy fibrous body with two short root-like arms, venting green spore clouds
creatures.minion: a tiny walking mushroom sprout, a small pale button cap over a thin stalk body with two little root arms, a faint puff of green spores
creatures.attack: bursting forward in a puff of spores

creatures.leader: a large translucent green slime, a heavy rounded blob of jelly with a darker acidic core and half-dissolved leaves and twigs suspended inside it, two glowing eye-spots
creatures.minion: a small translucent green slime droplet, a little rounded blob of jelly with a faint core and one glowing eye-spot
creatures.attack: rearing up and slamming down as a wave of acid

creatures.leader: a huge coiled swamp serpent, thick moss-green scales slick with algae, a broad flat viper head with amber eyes and dripping fangs, a ragged fin along its back
creatures.minion: a slender young swamp snake, thin moss-green scales, a narrow viper head with small amber eyes and short fangs

creatures.leader: a massive hulking fungus brute, a broad humanoid body of dense grey fibrous flesh with a huge dark bruise-purple cap for a head and thick knotted arms
creatures.minion: a small stooped fungus thrall, a wiry humanoid body of pale grey fibre with a small drooping purple cap for a head and thin arms
creatures.attack: swinging a heavy knotted fist downward

creatures.leader: a giant swamp wasp-fiend, an armoured black-and-sickly-yellow segmented body, four ragged translucent wings, barbed legs and a long dripping venom stinger
creatures.minion: a small swamp wasp drone, a slight black-and-yellow segmented body, two thin translucent wings and a short venom stinger
creatures.attack: darting forward and driving its stinger down

creatures.leader: a large murky brown swamp slime, a sagging blob of silt-thick jelly dripping mud, with bones and reeds suspended inside it and two dull glowing eye-spots
creatures.minion: a small murky brown swamp slime, a little sagging blob of muddy jelly with one dull glowing eye-spot
creatures.attack: rearing up and slamming down as a wave of muck

creatures.leader: a large horned fire imp, cracked charcoal-black skin glowing molten orange in the fissures, broad ember wings, long curved horns and clawed hands wreathed in flame
creatures.minion: a small horned fire imp whelp, dull charcoal skin with faint orange cracks, stubby ember wings and short horns

creatures.leader: a towering golem of fused basalt slabs with molten orange magma glowing between the plates, huge boulder fists and no face, smoke venting from its shoulders
creatures.minion: a small squat basalt golem, rough dark stone plates with thin molten seams, short blocky fists and no face
creatures.walk: striding forward with grinding stone steps

creatures.leader: a large hovering ember spirit, a bright roiling core of white-hot fire trailing long ribbons of flame and drifting ash, no solid body
creatures.minion: a small hovering ember mote, a dim flickering core of orange fire with a short trail of sparks, no solid body
creatures.attack: surging forward in a flare of fire

creatures.leader: a huge desert wyrm, a thick sand-scoured tan-scaled serpentine body with a ring of black hooked mandibles around a round maw, small vestigial claws
creatures.minion: a small desert wyrmling, a slender pale tan-scaled serpentine body with a small ring of hooked mandibles
creatures.attack: lunging forward with its maw of mandibles wide

creatures.leader: a tall risen desert wraith, a hollow tattered burial shroud of bleached linen streaming sand, empty glowing pale-blue eye sockets and skeletal grasping hands
creatures.minion: a small risen desert wisp, a short ragged scrap of bleached shroud trailing sand with a single faint pale-blue eye light

creatures.leader: a colossal weathered sandstone statue-golem, huge carved blocky limbs pitted by sand, faded ancient glyphs cut into its chest and a featureless carved head
creatures.minion: a small weathered sandstone construct, squat carved blocky limbs, a few worn glyphs and a featureless carved head
creatures.walk: striding forward with heavy grinding steps
creatures.attack: bringing a huge carved fist down

creatures.leader: a huge shaggy snow wolf, thick white-and-grey frost-rimed fur, pale blue eyes, long fangs and ice crusted along its back
creatures.minion: a small lean snow wolf pup, thin white-grey fur, pale blue eyes and short fangs

creatures.leader: a tall armoured undead warrior sheathed in blue-white ice, frost-cracked rusted plate, a frozen skull face with cold blue eye-lights, gripping a jagged icicle blade
creatures.minion: a small stooped undead thrall in cracked frozen rags, a frost-covered skull with dim blue eye-lights and bare bony hands
creatures.attack: swinging a jagged icicle blade downward

creatures.leader: a massive shaggy white beast built like a bear, slabs of blue glacial ice fused into its back and shoulders, a huge jaw of jagged ice teeth and small black eyes
creatures.minion: a small shaggy white beast cub, a few thin shards of blue ice along its back, a short jaw of ice teeth and small black eyes
creatures.walk: lumbering forward on four heavy legs
creatures.attack: rearing up and swiping with an ice-crusted claw
